field_notes: Raw detailed reports, every native update, measured binaries, full actual traces and optimizer/private recoveries remain local. Published aggregates omit duplicate evaluation vectors and preserve first/last updates plus full update count.
Grounded versus shuffled tests request alignment. Narration labels remain truthful for all arms; no-request retains prior V8 learning. No untreated or shuffled-production-label ablation.
No evaluation action is forced. First physical activity differs from eventual completion; food acquisition can precede ingestion.
Loss, gradients, logits and utterance counts establish no language competence. Sleep is induced native RecoveryProtocol, not spontaneous.

limitations: One common retained V8 history and seed; NoSpeech removes incremental teacher requests, not prior learning or truthful offline activity labels.
Training and assessment both stop request speech after any genuine completed activity; narration keeps the original three eligible quiet-row criterion.
GetFood ownership distinguishes noun choice from GetToy and action choice from EatFood. Missing physical activity classes receive no invented payload labels.
First-event discrimination is reported separately from eventual requested completion: grabbing food can be a legitimate prefix to eating food.
Native actor/Adam continuation across fresh cohorts; exact private/cold/sleep recovery is measured, not same-individual live optimizer rebase.
Induced RecoveryProtocol sleep, relocated contact/near fixtures and visible distractor; no spontaneous sleep or far-navigation claim.
Multiple targeted curriculum changes; no equal-dose old-objective arm, no real SLM delivery claim.
